commitResults.messageBody:
Add *.class to ignore all class files in the repo
Fill blanks within AGENTS.md file

Change all occurences of previous name Duke to
Nova within the repo

Used AI feedback to abstract String values into constants
Separated greeting and farewell into individual functions

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor echo based on AI feedback
commitResults.messageBody:
Check for end of file in determining whether the loop continues
Equality check for "bye" ignores casing and blank spaces

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for list to store tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Use arrayList to store inputs from user as tasks
Print out stored tasks with command list

Remove leading and trailing whitespaces from input tasks so the list of
tasks remain neat
Account for list command when list is empty, prompt user to add tasks
Account for empty input so that no "empty tasks" get added to the list

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor with a helper to print message
commitResults.messageBody:
Add printMessage helper to reduce excessive printing of the divider
lines
New class Task. List now stores Tasks instead of the previous String

Move the parsing of input from helpers into the loop (remove duplication)
Now splits every input into two parts - command and argument
Checks for the keywords "list", "bye" now conducted on command instead
of the entire input (as in previously). An input like "bye now"
will terminate the program
Valid "mark" or "unmark" command now comes with checks for invalid
argument - out of bounds index and non-numbers

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for 3 types of task
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement 3 types of task - ToDo, Deadline, Event using inheritance from
existing Task class.
Refactor the if-else blocks within the main while loop into switches
since all of them only involve comparing the first argument of input
given by user

commitResults.messageTitle: Format printed messages when adding the Task
commitResults.messageBody:
Printing of appropriate message when adding any one of the three tasks
abstracted into a helper that is called in each of the 3 cases within
the switch. Message printed changes depending on type of task (polymorphism)

commitResults.messageTitle: Account for edge cases in the 3 event types
commitResults.messageBody:
Each case now checks the arguments and their ordering instead of
assuming a perfect input from user every round.

Add handling for empty input after the command todo
Error handling for commands not belonging to the 3 classes and for the
deadline and event tasks already exist.

Use remove function of collections arraylist class to remove tasks from
the list.
Error handling for missing task number, invalid task numbers (out of
bound and non-integer values)

commitResults.messageTitle: Implement function to read data file
commitResults.messageBody:
The retrieveData function reads the data file './data/nova.txt' and
populates the arraylist before starting the main loop in the program

commitResults.messageTitle: Implement writing to nova.txt when adding tasks

commitResults.messageBody:
Called each time after adding a task, marking, unmarking and deletion
Removed previous writeTask function

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle missing and corrupted file scenarios

commitResults.messageBody: New classes Ui, Storage, Parser, TaskList were implemented

commitResults.messageTitle: Arrange classes into the same package nova
Add stricter constraints for date format
commitResults.messageBody:
Impossible days will smartly be interpreted as last day of the month.
Leap years are accounted for too.

JUnit tests for parseDateTime method of Parser class and toString
methods from task classes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JavaDoc header comments for all non-private classes and methods
Add find command to search task descriptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Locating a task currently means listing everything and reading it by
eye, which gets slower as the list grows. The number that mark and
delete need can only be obtained the same way.

Add TaskList.find(), returning the tasks whose description contains a
keyword. It returns a new TaskList rather than printing, so the class
stays out of the display business and a search never disturbs the
original list.

Match case-insensitively and on substrings, so "Book" and "book" behave
alike and "sport" reaches "join sports club". A stricter match would
miss more than it caught.

Generalise showTaskList() to take a list and a heading so list and find
share one renderer, with numbering restarting at 1 for filtered results
to match what the user sees.

Javadoc and naming in the touched files are brought up to the SE-EDU
coding standard along the way; Ui and Storage still need the same pass.
